embed.title: !invasion
embed.description: Same command as `{{prefix}}incident`: Team Rocket grunts and leaders, Giovanni, Kecleon, Pokemon Showcases and gold stops.

fields.name: Examples
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}invasion dragon` — dragon-type grunts
`{{prefix}}invasion boss` — Arlo, Cliff, Sierra and Giovanni
`{{prefix}}invasion kecleon`
`{{prefix}}invasion showcase`
`{{prefix}}invasion everything d:1000`
`{{prefix}}invasion remove everything`

fields.name: More
fields.value: `{{prefix}}help incident` lists every type, the gender filter and the other options.
